PERSONAL RECORDS
MAX
Heaviest weight you've ever lifted for a single set of this exercise. This star lights up when today's session beats that all-time best weight.
B.SET
Your best set — the weight × reps combination with the highest estimated one-rep max (weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30)). This can hit a new high even without adding weight — e.g. squeezing out extra reps at the same load.
VOL
Total volume — weight × reps summed across every completed set. Rewards the total work done in the exercise, not just one best set.
The number on each star shows how many exercises set a new record in that category this workout.
